superseded_preparation.rule: No r8 root, fixture, identity, certificate, credential, binding, config or runtime output is an r9 input.

fixture_first_correction.step_1: Create one fresh host-side Hub fixture with the supported interop_fixture empty-edge-binding scenario and fresh Edge installation, lineage, source, vehicle, VIN and car identities.
fixture_first_correction.step_2: Capture the fixture's authoritative returned hub_id in an owner-only receipt.
fixture_first_correction.step_3: Seal that exact returned hub_id and the six supplied identity relationships into the inactive binding.
fixture_first_correction.step_4: Validate the binding against the fixture result and the actual hub.sqlite opened mode=ro with PRAGMA query_only=ON.
fixture_first_correction.step_5: Run an in-memory hub_installation_id mismatch and require fail-closed rejection before PKI, Edge init, credential creation, guest work or runtime.
fixture_first_correction.step_6: Only after both validations pass, stage accepted binaries, generate one-use PKI, initialise inactive Edge state, enrol an expiring credential and write redacted public evidence.

focused_regression.negative_case: A modified in-memory binding Hub ID is rejected with hub_installation_id mismatch while the database bytes remain unchanged and no credential or runtime path exists.

accepted_immutable_builds.rule: Revalidate exact accepted source manifests and binary hashes, then copy those immutable build artifacts into the fresh r9 staging root. Do not rebuild unchanged binaries or rerun unrelated suites.

argv: the SHA-256 of the exact accepted r9 proposal
one_use_preparer.public_redaction: The public profile is redacted at first write. It records hashes for all seven identity relationships and withholds the synthetic VIN CommonName; no post-write redaction is planned.
one_use_preparer.failure_boundary: Any mismatch after the exclusive r9 root is created closes r9 without repair or reuse.

non_mutating_preflight.reviewed_exact_inputs: PASS 14/14 including the accepted Hub manifest and Edge receipt anchors
non_mutating_preflight.macos13_arm64_dhcp_lease: PASS; teslatls13arm64 currently maps to 192.168.64.10 without guest start
non_mutating_preflight.guest_root_absence: Must be checked immediately before any later guest copy; no guest was started for source-only preflight.

authority: After Edge independently accepts this exact corrected source package and fresh reservation, coordinator standing authority permits one r9 source/profile preparation without another confirmation. After both-owner acceptance of the concrete machine-written profile and inactive binding, it permits one zero-event baseline. No producer event is authorized.
proof_boundary: This is source, focused test and non-mutating preflight evidence only. No r9 root, fixture, PKI, credential, guest, listener, runtime, producer or event exists.
